source: lab (captured, background replaced by white via SAM2 segmentation)

camera.evidence: background is removed (pure white), so no background features to measure a shift against; both balls at rest in frames 0-10 stay fixed to <1 px, consistent with a static lab camera (no shake/pan detected)
camera.view: elevated camera looking obliquely down at the floor; near person at bottom-left (large, ~630 px tall visible), far person top-right (only waist-down visible, cut by the top edge). Floor itself is not visible (white).
camera.perspective_cues: no ground texture/horizon. Depth cues are apparent sizes: soccer ball (rolls away from camera) shrinks from ~79 px to ~59 px diameter then grows again to ~67 px; orange ball (rolls toward camera) grows from ~64 px to ~84 px. Larger image y (lower in image) = nearer the camera.

soccer_ball.desc: white soccer ball with black pentagons; starts at the near person's right shoe, bottom centre-left (cx~438, cy~687, touching the bottom image edge)

basketball_orange.desc: orange basketball with dark seams; starts at the far person's left foot, top-right (cx~828, cy~279)
basketball_orange.visible_frames: 0-48 (partly covered by the near person's hands 45-48)

person_near_left.desc: near person, long dark hair, dark grey T-shirt, black trousers, white sneakers; bottom-left, leaning back; kicks the soccer ball with the right foot, later bends forward and catches the orange ball
person_near_left.visible_frames: 0-48 (feet/legs cut by bottom edge; left edge cuts the body in frames 17-31)

person_far_right.desc: far person, light grey top, dark blue baggy jeans, white sneakers with black stripes; top-right, visible from the chest/waist down only (cut by the top edge at y=0); kicks the orange ball with the foot on the image-left side

watermark.desc: "Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo" grey label, bottom-right x>=1030, y>=690; not a scene object

events.event: both balls at rest at the two persons' feet (soccer ball at near person's right shoe, orange ball at far person's left foot)
kicks: near person's right foot pushes the soccer ball (it moves 4 px); far person's left foot touches the orange ball (orange still at rest)
both balls in motion (first large displacement 11->12: soccer ~70 px, orange ~28 px; unusually large -> a capture frame may be missing between 11 and 12)
soccer ball separates from the near person's shoe (merged with it in frames 12-13)
balls meet: image outlines touch/overlap (centre distance 58 px < sum of radii 66 px)

ball-ball contact / minimum image distance (47 px); soccer ball drops from ~14 to ~4-7 px/frame and turns from moving up-right to moving right-down; orange ball bends slightly (per-frame step ~(-11.3,+7.7) px in frames 20-23 vs ~(-11.7,+4.7) px in 28-31, ~12 deg flatter)
both balls show a double-size step 35->36 (orange 26 px vs ~13) -> probably a missing capture frame
near person's hand touches the orange ball (catch begins); ball still moving with the hands to 48
end: soccer ball still rolling right (~5-7 px/frame), orange ball held by near person

direction_notes.soccer_ball: frames 11-24 moves up-right (toward the far person/away from camera), after contact 25-26 moves right and slightly down (dx~+6, dy~+2 px/frame)
direction_notes.basketball_orange: frames 12-44 moves left-down toward the near person (dx~-12, dy~+5..+8 px/frame), approaching the camera
